svg.title: Skills Catalog Governance — Agent Skill Pipeline
svg.desc: Agent skill sources flow through governance stages (discover, group, council, consolidate, loss check, golden gate, benchmark, approval, promote) into a canonical verified catalog

g.text: similarity generates candidates · evidence determines promotion
211 skills discovered → 19 candidate families → Council verdict → 6/6 golden gate → 36/36 benchmark → 2 survivors promoted
